purpose: Review whether the frozen BTC v0.2 entry rule, and a volatility-scaled variant calibrated only on each asset's own development history, hold on non-BTC assets; screen candidate assets for the monitor. Research only: does not change crypto_market_regime_entry_v0.2.json, the live app or buy permission.
data_source: Coinbase USD spot daily candles (PIT: available_at = bar close + 1 day)

history.gap_note: Short exchange outages are tolerated; listing halts (months) cut history to the latest listing.

scaled_variant.method: Apply the frozen classifier to drawdown60 / k, i.e. zone depths -5k%, -8k%, -12k% and the Z0 no-chase band -2k%. Trend, stabilization, breakout and cooldown are unchanged.
scaled_variant.k_definition: std(daily log return of asset) / std(daily log return of BTC) over the same dates, measured on the asset's development segment only
scaled_variant.walk_forward_k: re-measured on each fold's training rows only

evaluation.baseline: simple >=5% pullback from prior 60D high, same cooldown, next-session open (unscaled for both variants)

screen.volume_note: Coinbase-only USD volume (close * base volume): a venue liquidity proxy, not global volume.

rule_fit: per asset: FROZEN_PASS, SCALED_PASS, BOTH_PASS or NEITHER_PASS on the OOS gate

recommendation_tiers.MONITORED: assets already in the monitor (BTC, ETH, SOL) are reviewed for rule fit, not tiered
recommendation_tiers.ADD_TO_MONITOR_CANDIDATE: screen eligible AND frozen or scaled threshold_validation PASS
recommendation_tiers.WATCH: screen eligible AND best variant passes >= 5 of 7 checks
